currentHardwareReason: The development host has no NVIDIA or Intel graphics device. Historical remote PASS applies only to its original source, executable, SDK, and driver fingerprints.
requiredEvidence: Exact source revision and dirty-source hashes, GN args and SDK headers/libraries hashes

Separate same-codec fallback identity and reason; software fallback must not satisfy hardware acceptance
Release return status including LastCloseStatus and SDK diagnostics; failed retirement must not become PASS
Producer single-frame Encode, key/delta frame, callback-arrival and callback-handling histograms; 0.1ms bucket upper bounds and overflow counts must remain explicit
Encoder pending peak=1, decoder pending peak, final and after-Release pending=0, actual Release call/error counts
Predeclared requested-vendor runtime SHA256 before/after the run and matching loaded-module path observed in the sender; QSV dispatcher-selected API/adapter diagnostics remain separate

commonExceptions.scope: Argument validation only; no claim about SDK initialization or encoding

commonExceptions.expected: H.264 uses OpenH264; H.265 uses x265 only when RTC_USE_X265 is enabled. Activate software only after successful hardware Release. Preserve codec and negotiated profile/level. Explicit vendor selection must not try another vendor.
commonExceptions.mockCoverage: vendor_close_status_unittest.cc checks shared adapter/wrapper retirement propagation. A fake backend cannot establish vendor API ownership or physical device-loss safety.

commonExceptions.expected: Record API name and vendor code, keep LastCloseStatus failed across repeated no-op Close/Release, reject Open on that backend, and never classify a failed cleanup as successful software fallback.
commonExceptions.remainingRisk: Retirement failure retains the bounded per-instance vendor resources at their original addresses, keeps failure sticky, rejects reuse, and performs no vendor cleanup retries. Restart the process before creating another hardware chain. Physical vendor ownership and device-loss retirement remain unverified; local mocks cannot establish them.

commonExceptions.procedure: On a dedicated test machine, use an operator-controlled device/driver reset while encoding. Capture API failures, diagnostics, process exit, resource state, and same-codec fallback outcome. Do not use an injected mock as the physical acceptance result.
commonExceptions.limitation: Synchronous vendor calls provide no hard in-process cancellation deadline. Validation-process timeout is an outer process bound.

longRunTemplate.reason: The shared two-process runner and PC executable accept --backend AMF|NVENC|QSV with strict actual hardware identity. NVENC/QSV physical acceptance remains DEFERRED on this host. Missing runtime, capability, SDK binding, pending/Release evidence or duration is FAIL in an attempted run; DEFERRED is a checklist status, never a fabricated PASS.
metrics: Per-process CPU normalized by measured logical processor count, actual callback receive FPS, private bytes/RSS, threads and handles
PID-filtered GPU Engine/GPU Process Memory counters with original engine names and LUID. Missing or combined engines remain UNKNOWN for independent VideoEncode utilization.
Unmodified producer single-frame Encode/key/delta/callback histograms: mean, P50/P95/P99 upper bounds, exact max and 2s overflow count; no queue or end-to-end latency claim
RTCStats interval average encode-duration distribution retained separately from single-frame latency
Encoder/decoder pending peaks, final/after-Release pending, actual Release calls/errors, and requested/actual hardware identity
For --source desktop, primary GDI source/capturer identity before/after, native dimensions, owner-thread teardown, capture errors and capture/conversion histograms
longRunTemplate.passBoundary: Hardware and fallback runs have independent results. Current source/SDK/executable/runtime fingerprints must remain unchanged; clean Release, zero pending and process exit are required. A provisional checkpoint or historical package PASS cannot replace final current physical evidence.
requiredPreparation: Run from the current WebRTC src checkout with a matching optimized PASS build ledger, current PC executable and GN args; retain exact source/SDK paths and hashes
NVENC binds the configured nvEncodeAPI.h and System32/nvEncodeAPI64.dll; QSV binds configured oneVPL headers/static vpl.lib and requires --qsv-runtime-dll ABSOLUTE_DISPATCHER_SELECTED_RUNTIME.dll
Determine the QSV hardware runtime path from current capability-probe MFX_IMPLCAPS_IMPLPATH diagnostics, retain API version and selected adapter LUID, and do not substitute a software runtime
H265 requires an absolute --ffmpeg-dll-dir containing the frozen FFmpeg 61/59 reference-decoder runtime and dependencies
